pipeline: YOLO11n bounding-box preprocessing -> engineered spatial/motion features -> Temporal Conv1D + BiLSTM
target_definition: weak/pseudo label: conflict_proxy at NEXT sampled frame, where proxy = pedestrian_in_ROI > 0 AND vehicle_in_ROI > 0
scope_note: This is a weakly supervised temporal conflict-screening model. Metrics measure agreement with the proxy label, not validated traffic-violation accuracy.
